name: blast-report-save-load-visual
description: Regression coverage for #571: a Blast Report modal, dismissed by a real click, must stay closed after a save+load round trip -- even past the ~3s real-time delay (BLAST_REPORT_DELAY_MS, BlastReportModal.ts) that would otherwise re-arm it. Before the fix, `load` replaced ctx.state wholesale with a *new* state.lastBlastReport object (deep-cloned from the save), and the modal's identity check (report !== lastShownReport) treated that new reference as a fresh, never-shown report -- reopening it ~3s later over whatever panel the player had moved on to. The fix stamps lastShownReport from the swapped-in state inside reset() (closeStaleLevelOverlays), so a report identical in content to one already dismissed does not re-arm. Sanity checks bracket the regression check: the modal must still genuinely open for a real new report (step 'blast'), and must still genuinely close on a real click (step 'dismiss report').

steps.description: Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open.

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:5 depth:6 start:15,15
steps.description: Two increment clicks on the spacing stepper raise it 3->5m before dragging, so the (15,15)-(20,20) rectangle computes the declared 2x2 instead of the default-spacing 3x3.

expect.note: 2 rows x 2 cols = 4 holes ordered (ghosts), none drilled yet (#553)

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan -- the staffed driller/drill_rig lands all 4 holes well inside this pad.
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

Fires the blast and waits out BLAST_REPORT_DELAY_MS (3000ms, BlastReportModal.ts) in real time so the report modal genuinely opens -- sanity check that the fix did not just disable the modal outright.

expect.note: sanity check: a genuinely new blast report opens the modal for real

steps.description: Dismiss the report through its real CLOSE button (data-action=report-close), not a console command -- the command field stays the inert `state` read since command mode has no DOM/modal to dismiss.

expect.note: sanity check: the real click actually closes the modal

steps.description: Save to real UI slot_1 via the Saves modal (SavesModal.ts) -- a separate, IndexedDB-backed path from the console save/load commands' in-memory slots. Command field stays inert; this step's real effect only exists through the clicks.

expect.note: the report modal, already dismissed above, stays closed through the save itself

steps.description: #571: load slot_1 back via the Saves modal's own Load button (main.ts's setOnLoad -> load command -> uiManager.closeStaleLevelOverlays), the click-driven path this whole scenario exists to exercise. This swaps ctx.state wholesale, giving state.lastBlastReport a brand-new object identity even though its content is the same already-dismissed report.

expect.note: reset() runs synchronously inside the load dispatch, so the modal is already closed the instant load finishes -- this alone does not yet prove the regression fixed, see the next step

steps.description: #571's actual regression check: wait out BLAST_REPORT_DELAY_MS again in real time with no further player action after load, then screenshot. Before the fix, BlastReportModal.update() saw the freshly-deserialized state.lastBlastReport as a never-shown report (reference != lastShownReport) and re-armed its 3s open delay right here, popping the CLOSE-already-clicked report back over whatever the player had moved on to.

expect.note: #571: modal must NOT have reopened -- this is the bug's own repro window
